author.name: チャエン | デジライズ CEO《重要AIニュースを毎日最速で発信⚡️》

tips: Claude CodeにSeedance 2.5、gemini-3.5-transcribe、gemini-3.1-flash-tts、X API v2をAPI連携し、Xリンクを入力するだけで動画生成までを自動化するワークフローを組む

en.content:
Build a workflow that integrates Seedance 2.5, gemini-3.5-transcribe, gemini-3.1-flash-tts, and the X API v2 with Claude Code, so that video generation is automated simply by entering an X link.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
[Breaking] Google has released Gemini 3.8 Flash. Low-cost models are starting to match the top tier.

Claude Opus 5 costs $5.00 per input, GPT-5.6 Sol costs $4.00. 3.8 Flash is $0.75, about one-seventh the price, while matching the major benchmarks.

・Coding: DeepSWE 73.7% (Opus 5: 74.0%)
・Terminal operations: 89.4%, surpassing Opus 5’s 89.1%
・Expert-level reasoning: HLE 54.9%, on par with Opus 5 and GPT-5.6
・Financial and legal agent tasks: No. 1 among all models

Strengths and weaknesses are in the thread below 👇 (figures measured by the company)
